description:
PagePilot is a serene, book-first e-book reader for iPhone, iPad, and Mac designed around effortless hands-free reading with your Apple Watch.

NEW IN PAGEPILOT 2.0

▸ Apple Watch Page Control & Bedside Hands-Free Lock
Turn pages on iPhone, iPad, or Mac with a subtle tap, Double Tap, or turn of the Digital Crown. Enable Hands-Free Bedside Lock to shield the screen from accidental touches and keep the display awake while your Watch or volume keys handle every page turn.

▸ Unified Desk & 5-Minute Micro Reading
Your Desk brings together your active book, tactile hardcover bookshelf, smart filters, and instant 5-Minute Micro Reading sessions — so even a short commute or quiet night becomes a finished chapter.

▸ Four Curated Paper Presets
Switch between Morning Paper, Sepia, high-contrast E-Ink, and gentle OLED Midnight directly from the floating reader dock, paired with estimated time remaining.

▸ Unified Journal & Single-Quote Postcards
Review your daily reading rhythm, 4-week activity heatmap, and quote box in one calm space. Turn any highlighted passage into a framable editorial Quote Postcard in Warm Paper, Midnight, or Dawn styles.

▸ Resume Book on Launch & Multi-Device Freedom
Optionally jump straight back to your last-read page on launch. Enjoy native sidebar navigation on iPad and Mac with multi-window reading, plus iCloud Sync across devices.

▸ Every Book, Effortlessly Imported
Supports EPUB, PDF, Markdown, TXT, Audiobooks, and CBZ. Import locally, drag-and-drop over Wi-Fi Transfer, send directly via Device Transfer, or browse OPDS catalogs. Built-in Text-to-Speech (TTS) supports all system voices.

PagePilot Pro unlocks unlimited books (free up to 10), unlimited highlights & notes (free up to 20), iCloud Sync, deep weekly/monthly/yearly stats & history, and Apple Watch page turning on iPad and Mac.

Basic Watch page turning on iPhone, Wi-Fi Transfer, and Device Transfer remain free forever.

whatsNew:
Introducing PagePilot 2.0 — a calmer, book-first redesign across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

New
• Unified Desk & Journal: Your reading hero, hardcover bookshelf, and 5-Minute Micro Reading now live together in Desk, while your 4-week heatmap and quote box come together in Journal.
• Hands-Free Bedside Lock: Shield the reading canvas from accidental touches and keep the screen awake while Apple Watch or volume keys turn every page.
• Four Curated Paper Presets: Switch effortlessly between Paper, Sepia, E-Ink, and Midnight right from the floating reader dock.
• Single-Quote Postcards: Turn any highlighted passage from the Reader or Journal into a shareable postcard in Warm Paper, Midnight, or Dawn themes.
• Resume Book on Launch: Enable the optional toggle in Settings to open straight to the page where you left off.

Improved
• Refined adaptive layouts for iPad Split View and Mac Catalyst, with quick paper presets and focus lock in the Mac reader toolbar.
• Estimated remaining reading time right in the reader dock and footer.
